decision: Graft C3 shared strings: streamed sst without count/uniqueCount, dedupe Map bounded at 64 chars and 500k keys

decision: Sheet and shared-string XML are written into growable byte buffers, not per-cell strings
why: per-cell strings spent 1.6 s of a 4.8 s 20 MB write in GC
evidence: core delegate 12578e1d profile; write 4.8 s to 3.7 s, peak RSS ~414 MB to 284-305 MB (Node 20, measured)

decision: Zip compression awaits the previous write instead of writer.ready
why: Node's CompressionStream reports ready until 16,384 chunks are queued, so ready gives no backpressure
result: at most two chunks in flight

decision: Rejection rules and the UTF-16 sniff run before a forced encoding applies
why: running the binary rule without the UTF-16 sniff would reject UTF-16 files the user forced
result: forced encoding never rejects what auto accepts
